meta.name: create-creator-takes-h3
meta.description: Generate an AI creator talking to camera, saying an approved script, as one continuous track — H3 Max reference-to-video through the GooseWorks fal-proxy (bills the Ads agent). Plans takes on line boundaries under H3's 15s cap, dry-runs a cost estimate, generates the first take alone so its voice can be locked and passed to every later take, joins takes with measured 0.10s dissolves, and moves each line's timing onto the words actually spoken. Use for any format with a generated creator speaking a script (split-screen, screen inserts, talking-head ads).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的口播脚本变成一段连续的数字人视频,自动拼接多个镜头。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把写好的口播脚本快速做成连续的数字人视频广告。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a written script into a continuous AI creator talking-head video.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want written scripts turned into continuous digital-creator video ads.

howto.what: Claude 会按你给的人物条件先生成一张创作者形象照,再把脚本按台词行边界拆成每段不超过 15 秒的片段,先单独生成第一条锁定声音供后面沿用,最后用 0.10 秒溶解拼成一条连贯出镜视频,并把每句台词的时间对齐到实际说出的词上。
howto.when: 当你需要让生成的 AI 创作者对着镜头念一份已定稿的脚本时触发,适用于分屏、屏幕插入、口播广告等格式。

say.text: 用 34 岁南亚女性、黑色中长发、深灰 T 恤、家庭办公室,生成创作者形象照
say.note: 先出静态照,只花几分钱,不生成视频

say.text: 按这份 cutlist 把脚本拆成不超过 15 秒的片段,先只跑第一条
把这几条片段拼成一条创作者视频,再把台词时间对齐到实际说出的话
say.note: 用 0.10 秒溶解拼接,输出一条连贯视频

howto.what_en: Claude builds a creator still from your choices, splits the script into takes under 15s, generates the first take alone so its voice locks for later takes, joins them with 0.10s dissolves, and moves line timings onto the words actually spoken.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need a generated creator speaking an approved script to camera — split-screen, screen inserts, talking-head ads.

say_en.text: Split this cutlist into takes under 15s and run only the first take
say_en.note: Dry run prints the cost estimate; add --go to generate

say_en.text: Join the takes into one creator video and align line timings to the spoken words
say_en.note: Uses 0.10s dissolves; outputs one continuous track
